# Tentmaker Strategies

> Tentmaker Strategies LLC is the consultancy of Adam Murphy, a strategist and
> systems builder based in Texas. The firm builds lead generation systems,
> marketing measurement infrastructure, AI search optimization, and custom AI
> implementations for ministries, nonprofits, and purpose-driven businesses.

## Key facts
- Founder: Adam Murphy (strategist and systems builder)
- Entity: Tentmaker Strategies LLC, Texas, founded February 2025
- Contact: adam@tentmakerstrategies.com
- Services: lead generation and campaign strategy, AI search optimization,
  AI systems and automation, web and digital rebuilds, organizational and
  business strategy
- Proof: 4,148+ measured leads generated across client campaigns in 2026
  across 8 countries; commercial clients in home services, real estate,
  and energy
